zotero.abstractNote: We move beyond law invariance and conduct a fundamental investigation of imprecise probabilities from a generalized frequentist viewpoint. Here, we challenge the assumption that a precise probability always suffices to capture the aggregate regularity of a data sequence, and show how imprecise probability naturally arises in the general case. To this end, we study imprecision under various data models. We furthermore propose a general framework for the evaluation of imprecise forecasts under such data models. Specifically, we develop viable notions of proper scoring rules and calibration for imprecise probabilities, generalizing their traditional correspondences.

extra.Part of the dissertation: Imprecise Probabilities in Machine Learning: Structure and Semantics
